description:
FILED s530b (Opus agent, 2026-10-31) when Template-Toolkit joined the board: the rows below are blessed to THIS task, with the first symptom read from a one-file run on the s530b tree (scratch/s530b/of2/t_<file>.out); each is to be REDUCED to a perl-vs-PCL probe and re-caused BY EDIT in baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv (split this task when the causes differ).  perl runs every one of them clean (prove -b, 121 files PASS).
- unicode.t rows 1-20 ("first try / in memory / from cache ... - UTF-8 / UTF-16BE / UTF-16LE / UTF-32BE / UTF-32LE"): every BOM-encoded template decodes wrong (Template::Provider's _decode_unicode: BOM sniffing + Encode::decode).
- string.t rows 79 81 83 (templates 38-40): `[% "   foo bar    " | uri %]`-style filters -- expect [foo%20bar], got [%20%20%20foo%20bar%20%20%20%20] (the trim before the escape is missing).
- proc.t rows 4-7: `[% USE ProcFoo %]` dies "Can't locate object method "new" via package "Template::Plugin::Template::Plugin::ProcFoo"" -- the PLUGIN_BASE prefix is applied TWICE.
- service.t rows 7 23: a PRE_PROCESS / PROCESS chain renders the wrong block (expect "This is a demo", got "Another template block, a is ''").
- stop.t rows 16 17: `[% STOP %]` inside a template reports "stop error - big error" where perl stops quietly.
- filter.t row 4: the file reads ZERO tests from its __DATA__ (plan 1..4 where perl plans 164), so `[% FILTER redirect('xyz') %]` never runs and t/test/tmp/xyz is missing.
- parser.t row 35 (template 12): `<break>` markers missing (expect "=foo\n<break>\nbar", got "=foo\n\nbar").
- zz-error-exception-gh-373.t row 4 (unnamed).

=== QUEUED (s530, Fable, 2026-10-31) ===
One of the 41 REAL whole-file CPAN board failures (the USER-asked review; 138 FAIL files = 69 perl-skips + 4 fixed + 2 perl-fails + 22 ruled not-supported + 41 real).  Queued as s531b member 10 (measure + split) -- `briefs-and-rules-for-claude-subagents/s530/s531a-prompt.md` / `s531b-prompt.md`.
